_: Names for the nameless (owner, 2026-09-23): the first time an addon introduces a generic NPC -- a Settler, a Drifter, anyone whose name is a label on five or more NPC records -- Rapport gives them a first name and a surname, the same ones forever. The lists are built into Rapport; add "female", "male" or "surnames" arrays here to replace one. "keep": names that are never labels (a real name the count gets wrong). "label": names that always are. Rapport-labels.txt next to Rapport.log shows what the count decided. The player's MCM [Names] section overrides "enabled"; scripts/build-mcm.py makes the MCM default from this file.
